lines.text: Working with Claude Code, you start in the loop.
So you hand them off, and step away.
And one of them stops. It needs you.
It floats above every app on your Mac, and watches them all.
Hover for every session. Click, and you're back in.
Four characters. Nine behaviours. Twelve faces.
No hooks. No settings to change. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Claude does the work. Vertex keeps you in the loop.
